title: Sr. Unica Admin
description:
Role: Sr. Unica Admin
Location: Remote
Rate: $70/HR

Top 3 Skills:
1. Unica administrator and Unica installation
2. Unix shell scripting and SQL Scripting
3. Web server administrator

Job Description:

Platform Management and Administration:
○ Serve as the primary administrator for the Unica Campaign and Unica Plan modules, ensuring optimal performance, stability, and security.
○ Perform regular system maintenance, including monitoring server health, managing user access and permissions, and implementing best practices for platform configuration.
○ Manage Unica-related databases, schemas, and tables, performing regular cleanup and optimization tasks.
○ Oversee the management of Unica listeners, ensuring seamless communication between front-end clients and back-end processes.
○ Monitor and troubleshoot system logs, error messages, and performance issues to proactively address potential problems.
○ Manage Unica partitions and security policies to ensure data integrity and access control.

Upgrade and Migration:
○ Lead and execute the end-to-end Unica platform upgrade process, including planning, testing, and deployment.
○ Develop comprehensive upgrade plans, considering in-place upgrades vs. fresh installations and managing the migration of existing objects (flowcharts, templates, etc.).
○ Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, database administrators, and marketing, to ensure a smooth and successful upgrade with minimal business disruption.
○ Provide expertise on new features and functionalities in newer Unica versions and advise on how to leverage them for business benefit.

Technical Support and Collaboration:
○ Act as the primary point of contact for Unica-related technical issues, providing timely and effective support to marketing and business users.
○ Work closely with campaign developers to troubleshoot flowchart issues, performance bottlenecks, and data-related challenges.
○ Collaborate with database teams to optimize SQL queries and ensure efficient data extraction for Unica flowcharts.
○ Provide training and guidance to junior administrators and end-users on Unica best practices and new features.

Security and Compliance:
○ Implement and maintain Unica security policies, user roles, and permissions to ensure compliance with internal and external regulations.
○ Manage and encrypt user and database credentials within the Unica platform.
○ Conduct regular security audits and maintain a secure and compliant Unica environment.

  • Experience with legacy system data extraction and integration tools.

title: Manhattan Deployment Project and Change Manager
description:
Trident Consulting is seeking a " Manhattan Deployment Project and Change " for one of our clients. A global leader in business and technology services

Position: Manhattan Deployment Project and Change
Location: Remote
Mode: Full-time
Salary Range: $130k - $145k/Annum

Description

Job Title:Manhattan Deployment Project and Change Manager
Location: Remote/Regional Travel Required

YOUR ROLE
As a Deployment Project & Change Manager, you will oversee and coordinate regional or configuration-based deployments of the Manhattan IT stack. You will manage execution timelines, ensure stakeholder engagement, and facilitate smooth transitions across all impacted operations.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
Project Management & Execution
  • Lead regional or configuration-type deployments of WMS/OMS systems across warehouse sites.
  • Develop and execute project plans including scope, milestones, risk assessments, and resource allocation.
  • Ensure adherence to deployment governance, documentation standards, and reporting structures.
  • Maintain close alignment with overall Program Director to ensure consistency and integration.
Change Management
  • Own the change management strategy for assigned regions or site groups.
  • Drive stakeholder engagement, change readiness assessments, and user adoption plans.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for on-site teams during implementation phases.
  • Coordinate cross-functional change activities between Operations, IT, and Customer teams.
Communication & Coordination
  • Ensure consistent communication across all constituencies, including warehouse teams, IT, customer stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • Resolve issues and escalations, capturing lessons learned to enhance future deployments.
  • Partner with Super User Team Managers and Implementation Engineers to support seamless execution.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Education & Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, IT, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience managing large-scale logistics technology deployments.
  • Proven track record in deploying Manhattan WMS and OMS products in 3PL or enterprise environments.
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies and tools (e.g., PMP, Agile, MS Project).
  • Experience in change management frameworks (e.g., ADKAR, Prosci).
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage across all organizational levels.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
WHAT WE OFFER
  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Generous paid time off and holidays.
  • Opportunities for career growth in a global organization.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Trident Consulting is seeking a " Software Developer” for one of our clients in Charlotte, NC.  A global leader in business and technology services.


Job Title: Software Engineer
Location: Hybrid – Charlotte, NC (3 days/week onsite)
Type: Contract (C2C)
Duration: 1 Year
Pay Rate: $60/Hr

Must Skill
  • Java and Java Backend
  • Spring boot
  • AI/LLM
  • AWS
  • Kubernetes
  • cloud-native AI deployments

Job Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer with strong backend development experience and a passion for integrating AI capabilities into enterprise systems. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Java ecosystems, modern software architecture, and hands-on experience with AI/LLM technologies.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop and maintain backend services using Core Java and Spring Boot.
  • Integrate AI/LLM workflows into Java applications using frameworks like Spring AI.
  • Design and consume RESTful APIs; familiarity with SOAP/WSDL/XML is a plus.
  • Build and support event-driven systems using Kafka, JMS, and other messaging platforms.
  • Collaborate on frontend development using frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
  • Implement observability tools for logging, metrics, and tracing.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Apply clean architecture principles and design patterns in system design.
  • Participate in technical discussions, mentor team members, and collaborate across teams.

Required Skills:
  • 7–10+ years of experience in Java development and Spring ecosystem.
  • Experience with AI/LLM integration in Java applications.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs and event-driven architecture.
  • Familiarity with frontend frameworks and responsive design.
  • Experience with observability tools (Logback, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Proficiency in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and version control systems.
  • Solid understanding of software design principles and architecture.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience with Spring Cloud and microservices components.
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Redis vector).
  • Knowledge of domain-driven design, CQRS, and reactive programming (Spring WebFlux).
  • Understanding of OAuth, JWT, and enterprise security protocols.
  • Exposure to cloud-native AI deployments (AWS Lambda, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI).
  • Experience with legacy system modernization and hybrid deployments.
  • Knowledge of AI orchestration, prompt chaining, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Experience with feature toggles, A/B testing, and canary deployments.
